title: SPARC Pig2 Acute Wired ColoMOCA Implantation
author: Brett Hanzlicek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfxgjpjw

steps.title: Prepare Anesthesia
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the pig and establish monitoring and fluid access.

substeps.instruction: Administer an intramuscular dose of telazol (4.4−6.6 mg/kg).
Intubate orotracheally and maintain on isoflurane in oxygen (1-5%, depending on anesthetic depth).
Monitor anesthetic depth via stimulus response, heart rate, respiratory rate, and eye position.
Place a peripheral catheter in an auricular vein for fluid administration.
Attach monitor sensors for BP, pulse Ox, EKG, and Temp.

steps.title: Perform Surgical Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the pig for surgery and clear the bladder.

substeps.instruction: Place the pig in a supine position.
Insert a 10F Dover catheter (Covidien; Catalog # 8887603101) into the urine bladder using a guidewire and tape it to the side of the pig.
Clean the midline suprapubic incision area with Betadine solution and isolate with sterile towels.

steps.title: Perform Initial Rectal Insertion
steps.instruction: Clear the rectum and insert the ColoMOCA device for initial testing.

substeps.instruction: Insert a speculum (anoscope) approximately 10 cm into the rectum and remove stool via manual disimpaction.
Insert the ColoMOCA into the rectum.
Place the receiving antenna (chataMOCA) on the lower abdomen of the pig and verify the wireless signal using Labview software.

steps.title: Conduct Initial Pressure Testing
steps.instruction: Measure pressure responses using the ColoMOCA and a reference catheter.

substeps.instruction: Insert a Laborie Balloon catheter 5 cm into the rectum using surgilube and remove the anoscope.
Press and hold the lower pig abdomen for approximately 5 seconds.
Record the response of the ColoMOCA pressure transducers using Labview and the pressure response from the balloon catheter using Laborie software.

steps.title: Test Electrode Measurements
steps.instruction: Evaluate the ColoMOCA electrodes using artificial stool.

substeps.instruction: Place artificial stool on top of the ColoMOCA.
Collect pressure and electrode measurements (conductivity, conductance, and capacitance) from the ColoMOCA.
Use the conductance reading to approximate volume.

steps.title: Remove Device
steps.instruction: Remove the ColoMOCA from the rectum.

steps.title: Perform Laparotomy and Implantation
steps.instruction: Surgically implant the ColoMOCA into the proximal colon.

substeps.instruction: With the animal in supine position, make a midline suprapubic incision to expose the peritoneal cavity and viscera.
Transition anesthesia from isoflurane to an IV infusion cocktail of propofol (2.0−4.4 mg/kg/h), midazolam (0.4−0.7 mg/kg/h), and fentanyl (0.003−0.005 mg/kg/h).
Incise the proximal colon, distal from the cecum, approximately 1 cm long.
Insert the ColoMOCA into the bowel through the incision.
Insert a balloon catheter next to the ColoMOCA for reference pressure.

steps.title: Verify Internal Implantation
steps.instruction: Test the implanted device and reference catheter.

substeps.instruction: Pressurize the balloon catheter by filling it with approximately 5 ml of water.
Record pressure from the catheter and the ColoMOCA.
Close the abdomen.

steps.title: Test Implanted Device Response
steps.instruction: Measure responses from the implanted device via external pressure.

substeps.instruction: Press and hold the pig abdomen where the ColoMOCA is implanted for approximately 5 seconds.
Record pressure, volume, conductivity, and capacitance measurements from the ColoMOCA and pressure measurements from the balloon catheter.

steps.title: Adjust Device Orientation
steps.instruction: Reorient the ColoMOCA sensors to face the colon wall.

substeps.instruction: Open the abdomen and rotate the ColoMOCA so that the pressure sensors face the wall of the colon.
Close the abdomen.

steps.title: Verify Adjusted Device Response
steps.instruction: Repeat the pressure test after device rotation.

substeps.instruction: Press and hold the pig abdomen where the ColoMOCA is implanted for approximately 5 seconds.
Record pressure, volume, conductivity, and capacitance measurements from the ColoMOCA and pressure measurements from the balloon catheter.

steps.title: Calibrate Manometry Catheter
steps.instruction: Calibrate the Laborie T-DOC air-charged anorectal manometry catheter on the benchtop.

steps.title: Final Stool and Dimension Measurement
steps.instruction: Perform final measurements with artificial stool.

substeps.instruction: Insert an anoscope and insert artificial stool so that it is on top of the ColoMOCA, then remove the anoscope.
Measure colon and stool dimensions, including thickness and impedances.
